newsitem.title: UK: Guinness indicated firmer in pre-market.
newsitem.headline: Guinness indicated firmer in pre-market.

text.p: Shares in Guinness Plc were indicated 6-1/2p higher to 492-1/2 by 0814 GMT in pre-market trade, after the drinks group reported slightly firmer than expected profit growth in 1996.
The company, whose brands include Johnnie Walker Red Label Scotch whisky as well as Guinness stout, said it saw signs of better demand and pricing in the U.S. spirits market -- it's biggest.
"At first glance the figures were pretty much as expected but the trading statement was fairly positive," one market maker said.
"We'll probably see an early mark-up but I'm not sure if there is enough here to really send the shares(up) - the market is pretty nervous."
Full-year pre-tax profits rose to 975 million stg versus analysts' expectations of 960 to 965 million stg. The 12-month dividend of 16.1 pence per share was in-line with market forecasts.
Elsewhere in the sector, Allied Domecq was indicated up 5p to 462-1/2, while Grand Metropolitan rose 4p to 497-1/2.
